content_sections.heading: About NHSRC Technical Officer (PMDT)
content_sections.text: National Health Systems Resource Centre (NHSRC) is based in New Delhi. In this notice it is recruiting on behalf of the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare for a Technical Officer to work on PMDT with the Central TB Division. The officer handles PMDT correspondence and supports the division's work with DRTB centres, states and districts.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: MBBS from institution, recognized by Medical Council of India. Working knowledge of computers. Five years of post-qualification experience preferably in tuberculosis control. Post-qualification experience is listed as a preferential qualification, not an essential one. The age limit is "Upto 65 years". The notice gives this together with a second requirement: the candidate must be ready to travel extensively. The notice does not print a cut-off date for counting age or any age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The notice gives the remuneration as a range: between Rs. 90,000/- and Rs. 1,30,000/- per month. It does not say how the amount within this range is fixed for a candidate. The post is offered purely on a contractual basis. The notice does not mention the length of the contract, HRA or any other allowance.

content_sections.heading: NHSRC Technical Officer (PMDT) Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice lists these responsibilities for the Technical Officer (PMDT): To handle correspondence at Central TB Division pertaining to PMDT. To assist the Central TB Division in assessing the population/geographic need of DRTB centers. To assist the CTD to facilitate the states for universal DST and treatment services. To mitigate treatment initiation delays. To ensure timely submission of periodic PMDT reports by the districts, DRTB centres and states. To ensure proper functioning of supply chain management of second line drugs, and to initiate actions to fill the gaps. This is done by reviewing: the quarterly PMDT reports; district/state quarterly reports on program management and logistics; monthly state drug store reports on second line drugs. To support mortality reduction activities like differential TB Care among TB patients. To assist in timely revisions/updates of technical and operation guidelines based on evidences and changes in policies. To assist in preparing reports on program performance for the government and stake holders based on pre-defined indicators. To support ADR monitoring and management activities. To conduct supervisory visits to states/districts as per program needs. To assist and or conduct in organising trainings/meetings. To work in collaboration with technical officers of other thematic areas of the program on cross cutting issues. To facilitate change management with respect to use of ICT & Nikshay tools for concerned data entry, validation and its use for public health action. Any other job assigned as per programme need.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NHSRC Technical Officer (PMDT)
content_sections.text: Applications are made online only. The notice gives the following instructions: Go to the NHSRC website ( http://nhsrcindia.org ), where the online application is available. Fill in the online application correctly. Submit the application in the prescribed online application format. No other format is accepted. Make sure the application is received by 30 November 2026, the last date for receiving applications.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice does not describe the selection stages. It sets one condition: if the recruitment process includes a written test, the minimum qualifying mark will be 70%.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NHSRC Technical Officer (PMDT) post?
faq.answer: The last date for receiving applications for the NHSRC Technical Officer (PMDT) post is 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What qualification is required for NHSRC Technical Officer (PMDT)?
faq.answer: Candidates need an MBBS from an institution recognized by the Medical Council of India, along with working knowledge of computers.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the NHSRC Technical Officer (PMDT) post?
faq.answer: The age limit is upto 65 years. Candidates must also be ready to travel extensively.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of NHSRC Technical Officer (PMDT)?
faq.answer: The remuneration ranges between Rs. 90,000/- and Rs. 1,30,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the NHSRC Technical Officer (PMDT) post?
faq.answer: Fill in the online application on the NHSRC website (http://nhsrcindia.org). Applications are accepted in the prescribed online application format only.

faq.question: Q6. Is experience required for NHSRC Technical Officer (PMDT)?
faq.answer: Experience is a preferential qualification, not an essential one. The notice prefers five years of post-qualification experience, preferably in tuberculosis control.

faq.question: Q7. Is the NHSRC Technical Officer (PMDT) post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The post is offered purely on a contractual basis.
